_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so an Industry extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. input_shortage) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE) (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). In Industry the CONDITION-CODES (input_shortage, equipment_failure...) never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger (which are FREE-TEXT phrases like 'Line stoppage'); this table bridges them. Industry follows the ENERGY pattern (free-text triggers), NOT the Finance pattern (diagnosis-id triggers): the alias expansion is STRICTLY REQUIRED here because a trigger like 'Line stoppage' can never self-match a condition-code or a diagnosis id.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(industry-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L140-168)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L178-181)--> diagnosis id --(industry.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations)--> each activation's FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers. Both hops are pure data + the pulse-engine family switch; no link invented.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, L178-181, NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that is only a diagnosis secondaryConfirmation but does not emit that diagnosis requiredFamily is listed under secondaryDiagnoses and NOT folded (bias against over-marking).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from industry.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceAndEnergy: (1) TRIGGER TYPE: Industry activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases (like Energy), NOT diagnosis ids (unlike Finance) — so the alias table is strictly load-bearing, as in Energy. (2) SHARED-FAMILY CROSS-LINKS: Industry contracts share evidence families across diagnoses, so single condition-codes fold into TWO diagnoses. 'pmi_event' is required by BOTH SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE and AUTOMATION_FAILURE, so every supply/capacity condition folds into both; 'regulatory_event' is required by BOTH TOXIC_SPILL and QUALITY_CRISIS, so every safety/quality condition folds into both. Finance families were more siloed per diagnosis. (3) ORPHANS: Energy 1, Finance 3, Industry 0 — every activation carrying non-empty diagnosticTriggers appears in an _authored circuit; the only non-circuit activations (TPJ, DMN, PRECUNEUS, WERN) all have EMPTY triggers and are extinction-exempt. (4) DEAD-END FAMILIES: structural_event (from industry_high_stress/structural_stress) and macro_event (from macro_shock) are emitted but named in no contract requiredFamilies, so they reach no diagnosis (like Finance macro_shock).

SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.basis: diagnosis id === Industry issue id; when active, the (energy-pattern) adapter marks its issues['SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE']._authored circuit nodes active (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L79-101). This alias lists exactly those brainNodeIds and their activations' free-text diagnosticTriggers. Direct data link, no inference. Because Industry triggers are free-text (Energy pattern), this expansion is what actually protects the circuit nodes from extinction.

conditionCodes.reason: industry-pulse-engine.js classifies industry_high_stress -> [structural_event] (L166), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists structural_event in requiredFamilies. The family is a dead-end: it reaches no diagnosis, hence no _authored circuit, hence no activation. No grounded alias. (Analog of Finance _stress_* exclusion; here it is a catch-all stress token that no contract consumes.)

industry-pulse-engine.js classifies structural_stress -> [structural_event] (L166). structural_stress IS listed as a WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE secondaryConfirmation token, BUT it emits only structural_event, not the WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE requiredFamily labor_event, so per the code gate (requiredFamilies OR-semantics, L178-181) it cannot validate WORKFORCE_SHORTAGE and is NOT folded. structural_event is consumed by no contract, so there is no defensible condition->diagnosis link.

unmapped.activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc: ZERO orphans. Every activation in industry.json that carries non-empty diagnosticTriggers (M1, dACC, S1, HYPO, CBLM, THAL, HIPP, FG, CeA, dlPFC, SMA, FPN, STRI, ENS, AG, OFC) appears in at least one issue._authored circuit, so extinction always has a live trigger source for it.
